title: Your Name
author: Your Name
description: A digital garden of notes, books, photographs and travels.
heroTitle:
Hello, I’m Your Name.
Welcome to my garden.
heroIntro: This is a slowly growing collection of notes, essays and half-formed ideas, along with the books I’ve read, photos from my life and the places I’ve been.
gardenIntro: Notes, essays and half-finished thoughts, growing at different speeds. Nothing here is ever really done.
booksIntro: What I’m reading, what I’ve read, and the growing pile waiting for me.
photosIntro: Moments from my life, roughly in order.
travelIntro: Where I’ve been, how I got there, and how long I stayed.
footer: Grown with plain text and patience.
